jobs.occupation: Senior Data Security Engineer
jobs.description:

You will translate complex regulatory and data risk requirements into scalable, effective technical controls that safeguard sensitive information and strengthen Saxo’s security posture.

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to Saxo’s broader agenda around security, governance, and operational resilience within a highly regulated financial environment, working closely with stakeholders across technology, compliance, and the business.

• Design and implement data protection controls across Microsoft Purview (DLP, Information Protection, Insider Risk Management)

• Translate data security risks and regulatory requirements into robust, enforceable technical solutions

jobs.occupation: ASIC/FPGA Design and Verification Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you a design or verification engineer with ASIC/FPGA skills, and do you have a flair for client communication? If so, then SyoSil has a great career opportunity for you.

SyoSil will soon initiate a new project, for which we search for new team members to join our existing staff of 20 highly qualified ASIC engineers. We both look for seniors as well as newly graduated engineers.

The project will focus on digital design and verification for an RF radio ASIC, being part of a large international multi-team project. In this project, SyoSil will assume the full responsibility of several IP blocks, from architecture definition towards RTL design and coverage driven verification closure. Design and verification will be done using SystemVerilog and UVM. The project management will be SCRUM based.

We offer:

• A challenging role where you work closely with a highly skilled team as well as interfacing to engineers in leading international companies

• Access to the latest technologies and ongoing professional development, including training with ASIC tools from the top EDA vendors in the SyoSil partnership portfolio

• A competitive salary and a flexible working environment

SyoSil is a market leader in the ASIC R&D space, including RTL design/verification, device firmware and tool development. Our clients include top European and U.S. semiconductor companies working in specialized fields, such as the automotive, surveillance and telecommunication industries.

**Join an international team of specialists

**

You will join a young and dynamic team of 20 engineers in a vibrant international environment close to central Copenhagen, Denmark. Contributing to large-scale project execution, you will collaborate closely with experienced and highly skilled colleagues who are all specialists within their field, giving you a unique opportunity to learn and grow.

**Take part in large-scale project execution

**

As an ASIC/FPGA design and verification engineer, you will contribute to execution of projects on a large industrial scale, from concept and specification through RTL design to verification based on coverage closure. You will also deliver turn-key verification flows, verification IP and lead projects based on established and upcoming industry standards (SystemVerilog/UVM), helping clients improve their design and verification methodologies.

In relation to this, you can look forward to some international travel to liaise with clients and project execution.

**The ideal candidate

**

Experience from the industry is a plus, but not essential. What matters most is that you are skilled within ASIC/FPGA design, thoroughly systematic in your work and know how to solve parallel problems simultaneously. Furthermore, you need to have good communication and presentation skills, enabling you to establish and develop strong client relations. In addition:

• You have a B.Sc. or an M.Sc. in electrical engineering or computer science, and you know how to debug complex systems in a traditional ASIC/FPGA design simulation environment.

• You have solid skills within RTL module design (Verilog/VHDL), and/or experience in verification using constrained random verification methodologies, (SystemVerilog/UVM).

• It is a strong plus if you are familiar with digital signal processing / filter design.

• It is also an advantage if you are familiar with C++ or Python and able to debug complex software systems in a traditional Linux-based software environment.

• You speak and write English fluently, and preferably Danish too.

If you recently graduated with very good results we strongly encourage you to apply for this position, as we are open towards investing in training you for the position.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Peter Jensen at peter@syosil.com.

Please apply for the position by sending your application to Peter Jensen at peter@syosil.com.

jobs.occupation: Associate Director, Product Innovation
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about finding new drug opportunities? Do you love understanding disease biology to guide the best possible drug design? Are you a seasoned professional and looking for the next step?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Associate Director, Product Innovation.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and expanded portfolio. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Ascendis Pharma is expanding our Product Innovation department and searching for an Associate Director to help drive the future pipeline and the company’s growth towards 2030 and beyond.

The Product Innovation department’s primary objective is to conduct analysis and propose new potential products for the company pipeline. With Patients in mind, new lead finding is based on thorough analysis which typically includes disease biology, unmet medical need, market assessment, competitive intelligence, FTO and assessment of path to FiH. With “Science” as a fundamental corporate value, analysis is rooted in a deep biological understanding of the disease, available (pre)clinical data, Mode of Action across modalities/lines of treatment and the impact a given molecular design/TPP will achieve. As a critical function to building Ascendis Pharma’s future, the Product Innovation department has high exposure to executive management and works closely with adjacent functions.

The Associate Director Product Innovation will play a critical role in Ascendis' success in Endocrinology Rare Disease as well as novel therapeutic areas. She/He will be the driving force behind providing high-quality analysis and pitch decks which enable value-oriented and informed decision-making by the EMT. By gathering, analyzing, and transforming data into concise, actionable ideas, you will play an important role in shaping the future pipeline.

You will be joining the Product Innovation team and report directly to Steffen Nyegaard, Director, Product Innovation who is based in Hellerup_. You will also be based in Hellerup.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Identification of new drug candidates and indications of interest

• In-depth analysis of diseases, treatment guidelines, competitive environment, how different MoA will affect the disease pathology, market and patents into final reports

• Act as strategic thought partner across different functions and teams, e.g. supporting early research projects or conducting deep-dive analytics to support key business decisions

• Staying current in relevant fields and tracking news widely (e.g., scientific literature, analyst reports, regulatory documents) and share findings with key stakeholders

• Establish processes, structures, and templates when necessary to support Ascendis' growth

Qualifications and Skills:

You have a PhD in life sciences and preferably post doctorial experience from a leading university or group. The ideal candidate has significant experience in lead finding and drug development and knows how to leverage their knowledge into actionable outcomes. The candidate possesses a strong biological profile, which enables them to quickly learn and understand novel biological systems, identify critical issues and unmet needs, and generate analyses with high level take-home and next-step recommendations.

Ideally**, you have:**

• 5 years of industry experience from Pharma or biotech within research or BD

• A strong biological profile with documented track record from the apex of the field

• Significant work experience with the different functions within the pharma value chain

• Experience in the use of public and private databases (e.g. Patsnap, Cortellis, Globaldata, Evaluate or similar)

• The ability to synthesize complex information to both high scientific and layman levels and present it in a clear, actionable manner

• English at a professional level, both written and spoken, and you master MS Office

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

You are passionate about science, love learning and have a deep understanding of disease biology

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to demonstrate strong stakeholder management and communication skills, high personal and scientific integrity and the ability to navigate complex environments.

Travel: 20-30days per year.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup, Denmark

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

jobs.occupation: Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS, Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for colleagues to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

You will be working in an enthusiastic Process Automation team with more than 80 colleagues in Denmark. Globally, the Process Automation team has more than 200 employees.

The Process Automation team works with consultancy, design & development, implementation and validation of Automation solutions for the Pharma and Biotech industries. Our work is project based, and currently we are looking into an exciting pipeline of large data driven, greenfield plants with modular/scalable designs.

We are skilled in a broad range of process areas within API production e.g. fermentation, recovery and purification, utility, and cleaning systems. And the solutions we provide to our customers are always based on a deep understanding of the customers’ production processes – and if standard components can’t do the job, we develop our own.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Senior Process Automation Engineer, you’ll be:

• Advising customers on their application process solutions

• Design developing, programming, commissioning, qualifying, FAT, SAT, UAT and Handover of applications for Distributed Control Systems (DCS)

• Interacting with process experts and colleagues with expertise in surrounding systems and equipment like MES, Historian systems, instruments, production equipment etc.

• Developing and optimizing automation methods and strategies to meet our customers’ needs and sharing working knowledge with colleagues and partners

• Forming the basis of automation strategies and architectures to support our sister departments internationally and expand NNE’s Process Automation engagement

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Understand your colleagues’ individual and cultural difference

• Are aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Are agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Are team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Are reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Are appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have 6+ years or more of working experience and hold a degree as an engineer, ideally within electrical, automation, process or marine engineering

• You have 4 years or more of working experience with PCS/DCS Application development (for example ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine), working in GMP/GAMP environment or with execution of Automation projects

• Knowledge of batch production is valued

• You find the complexity of the GMP/GAMP environment exciting

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. • Provide your guidance and input in your specific expert areas across the whole organization

• Experience from oilfield, energy sector, hydraulics, precision mechanics, electro mechanical systems, mechatronics or similar is a plus

• Takes ownership of tasks and projects – enjoys broad responsibility

• Agile Project Management skills

Director Specialist – Key Account Management (Power & Controls)

Build strategic partnerships that power the future of renewable energy

At KK Group, we are on an ambitious journey to enable a future powered by renewable energy. We are looking for a commercially driven and relationship-oriented leader to take ownership of a key strategic account and help unlock its full potential.

In this role, you will work at the heart of our business—connecting customers, technology, and operations—to drive sustainable growth, strengthen long-term partnerships, and deliver real impact.

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark, Ikast

Key Account Management:

• Obtain detailed knowledge of the account’s organization, their product portfolio, their on-going projects, and secure this is shared across commodities.

• Process customer RFQ’s and work cross-functionally with colleagues to generate the best technical and commercial offering

• A basic understanding of electromechanical components and industrial environments

• Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience in budgeting, performance management, and delivering on business targets

• Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and align expectations across internal and external partners

• Proven experience in leading cross-functional teams and managing complex projects in an industrial or technical environment

• A structured, analytical, and data-driven mindset, enabling you to translate insights into impactful decisions

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels in a global setting

• A collaborative and inclusive leadership style, with a commitment to safety, quality, and company values

• Cross-cultural awareness and the ability to operate effectively in an international matrix organisation

Ready to make an impact?

If you are excited about shaping strategic partnerships and contributing to the renewable energy transition, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now & send us your resume in English.

Due to the summer vacation period in Denmark, all applications will be processed only in the beginning of August.

Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

Potential Benefits (Depending on Role)

If the above matches your field of interest and your qualifications, please send your application and resume as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

For further information, please contact:

Karen Lim  +45 4194 6883

KK Group is a global technology partner delivering power, controls, cooling, monitoring and service solutions for renewable energy and energy-intensive industries.

With more than 45 years of experience in the wind industry and technologies installed in over 120,000 turbines worldwide, KK Group provides critical electro-mechanical systems that enable electrification, improve energy efficiency, and optimise the lifetime performance of industrial assets.

The company’s capabilities span the full value chain - from development and manufacturing to service and digital solutions - supporting customers across the entire lifecycle of their platforms. Backed by its long-term owner, A.P. Moller Holding, KK Group is expanding beyond wind into selected energy-intensive industries including hydrogen, mining, rail and defence.

Today, KK Group employs more than 3,700 people across 10+ countries and is building a more diversified, resilient and global business - Powering Change towards a more sustainable tomorrow.

Drive product-level requirement definition, functional specifications, technical governance, and change management.

Contribute to product roadmap development, ensuring alignment with market trends, grid requirements, and future hybrid power plant needs.

Support cost‑optimization, manufacturability, and quality initiatives to ensure a price-competitive product.

Maintain system documentation, design rules, product configuration guidelines, and compliance packages.

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, Controls Engineering, or a related field.

Strong understanding of grid‑scale BESS architecture and system integration.

Experience working with multiple subsystems such as PCS, battery containers, AC Skids, and EMS/plant controllers.

Ability to define system requirements, specify subsystem interfaces, and validate system integration.

Understanding of grid interconnection requirements, certifiable standards, and BESS compliance guidelines.

Experience with customer technical discussions, system sizing, and solution definition.

Nice‑to‑haves:

Experience in hybrid power plant solutions (BESS + PV + WTG).

Familiarity with European grid codes (ENTSO‑E, national TSO/DSO requirements).

Background in product ownership, system engineering, or platform leadership.
